title: Meeting Jo Jones and Prez in Chicago
summary: Roy befriended Prez and Jo Jones in Chicago, picking them up in his new Ford Roadster after work.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: Yeah. Well, going back to the Three Deuces thing, that's when I first met Jo Jones. Prez I knew from when I was with McKinney's Cotton Pickers in Baltimore, you know.
Oh, you had met him there.

Yeah, we used to jam together. That's how I met him, you know. I remember when I used to pull little stunts that I heard...what Horace Henderson used to tell me. I'd go into jam sessions and make like I was so drunk I couldn't play, you know, then wake up, get up like in a stupor -- get up and blow everybody off the floor! Making the fantasies come true.
So me and Prez... You know, Prez was with Fletcher at that time, and they were giving him a bad time. He didn't

hang out with nobody. Nobody dug him after Coleman left. That's how we became very good friends, you know. And he introduced me to Jo, and I used to pick them up every night. I had a new Ford Roadster, which I loved. Man, I used to sit in the window and watch that fella; I did that for three months. I'd come down and shine it, you know...

Funny story about that roadster. When I got it, the (?) with ...(? )...(? )... When I got it, it was a nice day. So me and Don and (?), we decided to take a ride. So I told them, "Well, put the top down for me," we'll put the top down and ...(? )... So we struck out. Man, we were riding and riding, and it started to rain -- and I didn't know how to put the top up. And we got soakín' wet. We pulled up at the gas station, and had the guy fix it for us.
But I used to pick them up every night after work, you know...
They were working at the Grand Terrace?

Basie had just come to the Grand Terrace. We picked up...heard Red Saunders at the DeLisa. I remember a ...(? )... Joe says we put him in the DeLisa. But we didn't put him in the DeLisa. He lived in Chicago, and they wanted a drummer and they got him, you know. But Joe always says that we put him in the DeLisa, but we didn't put him in there, man.
